title: Radio, 09:45: Riverside Sweep Complete, Vault Breaker Go Needed

fields.centerName: MSU Emergency Operations Center, Campus Services Building Room 108

lines.text: Chief, Sergeant on Riverside. We finished the final floor-by-floor sweep with a Marlowe Fire crew. Doors knocked and master-keyed on all 11 floors. We found two residents on floor 10. One was asleep with headphones in, one came back for a laptop. Both are walking to Kessler with an officer now. Both elevator cars are at the lobby, empty and locked out. Nobody's on the roof. The roof hatch is padlocked from the inside and nobody has touched it. I'm the last one out unless you tell me otherwise.

EOC, Riverside. Here's the update on the 15 not on any list. The 2 from the sweep are now accounted for. 6 more replied to their RA's group text saying they slept off campus last night, but we have no face-to-face confirmation for them. 7 are still unconfirmed, and one of them is on the fourth floor. The sweep found nobody on four. The 3 walk-ins at Kessler who say they live in Riverside still aren't on my roster.
Ops, the stage is 10.3 and water is seeping under the vault door. I need the go to open the main breaker in the next ten minutes, or I'm pulling out of here myself.

fields.voiceStyle: Three speakers. Sergeant: middle-aged male, steady and methodical, slightly winded from the stairs. Residence director: female, thirties, tired but precise, reading off sheets. Electrician: male, forties, clipped and tense, getting more urgent.

instructorNote: Scenario time 09:45. This converges three tracks. Watch for the IC to confirm the building and elevators are clear, log the time and the basis, and give Fac the go to isolate Riverside power before the basement floods. DoS should keep the 7 listed as unconfirmed, not absent, keep trying to reach them, and check the 3 walk-ins with Housing. Any reply to the fourth-floor parent should go through the FERPA consent or health-and-safety exception decided with University Counsel. CPD should pass the report that nobody is on the roof to the PIO for the rumor correction.
